Disclaimer – Please Read Carefully

Welcome to IMRango. This disclaimer explains the limitations of our calculators, our approach to cookies and third-party ads, and what you need to know before using our site.

Please read this page carefully. By using IMRango, you agree to the terms outlined here.

1. No Medical Advice

IMRango is a measurement resource, not a medical service.

  • We provide sizing estimates based on standard industry formulas.
  • Our calculators are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
  • If you have concerns about breast health, chest pain, asymmetry, or any medical condition, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.

Your health and safety are important – always make informed decisions with the help of a doctor.

2. Sizing Estimates Only

All calculators on IMRango provide estimates, not guarantees.

  • Bra fit varies by brand, style, fabric, and individual body shape.
  • Your calculated size is a starting point – we recommend trying on bras for the best fit.
  • We are not responsible for purchases made based on our estimates.

We encourage you to try on multiple sizes and sister sizes to find what feels comfortable for you.

3. How Our Calculators Work

All calculations on IMRango run locally in your browser.

  • We do not send your measurements to any server.
  • We do not store or collect your data.
  • Your privacy is protected – no one sees your numbers but you.

4. Cookies & Third-Party Advertising

IMRango does not use cookies directly. We do not set first-party cookies for tracking, analytics, or personalization.

However, we may display third-party advertisements (such as Google AdSense) on our site. These third-party ad networks may use cookies or similar technologies to show relevant ads. This helps us keep our calculators completely free for all users.

How to Opt Out of Third-Party Cookies

If you prefer to disable third-party advertising cookies, you can:

  • Visit the Google Ad Settings page to manage your preferences.
  • Use the Network Advertising Initiative (NAI) opt-out page to opt out of multiple ad networks.
  • Adjust your browser settings to block third-party cookies entirely.

Please note: blocking cookies may affect how ads are shown to you, but it will not affect the functionality of our calculators.

5. Third-Party Links

IMRango may contain links to third-party websites (such as brand size charts, guides, or external resources).

  • We do not control or endorse these external sites.
  • We are not responsible for their content, privacy practices, or accuracy.

We recommend checking the privacy policy and terms of any external site you visit.

6. No Warranties

IMRango is provided "as is" and "as available" without any warranties of any kind.

  • We do not guarantee that our calculators will be error-free, uninterrupted, or always available.
  • We are not responsible for any loss, damage, or inconvenience caused by using our site.

We do our best to keep everything accurate and functional – but we're human, and mistakes can happen.

7. Changes to This Disclaimer

We may update this disclaimer occasionally to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements.

The latest version will always be posted at this URL. We encourage you to check back periodically.

8. Contact Us

Have questions about this disclaimer? We're happy to help.

📧 info@iamrango.com

We'll reply within 24–48 hours.
